releases.body:
## Fixed
- Theme color consistency: All text elements now properly follow the opencode theme
  - Use t.text for title and active agent names
  - Use t.textMuted for inactive agents and status text
  - Matches tokscale plugin color pattern

## Changed
- Replaced color attribute with fg attribute for theme compatibility
- Removed unnecessary toHex() conversion - theme values are already strings

## Technical Details
```
// Before (broken)
const accent = toHex(t.primary) ?? "#82AAFF"
const dim = toHex(t.textMuted) ?? "#546E7A"
<text color={accent}>Olympus</text>

// After (fixed)
const fgColor = t.text ?? "#EEFFFF"
const dim = t.textMuted ?? "#546E7A"
<text fg={fgColor}>Olympus</text>
```

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/akasai/omo-olympus/compare/v0.2.8...v0.2.12

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

### Server Plugin Crash Resolved

Fixed a critical crash caused by named exports in server plugins. The opencode plugin loader only supports export default - any named exports cause the module to fail loading.

Root Cause:
```
export function inferAgent(...)  // ❌ Crash
function inferAgent(...)         // ✅ Works
```
## ✨ New Features

### Enhanced Agent Detection Hooks

- tool.execute.after - Detects subagent task completion

- command.execute.before - Mode switching via commands (/plan → Prometheus)

- experimental.chat.system.transform - Detects mode from system prompt

## 📦 Installation
```
// opencode.json
{ "plugin": ["omo-olympus@latest"] }
// tui.json
{ "plugin": [["omo-olympus@latest", { "enabled": true }]] }
```

## 🎓 Lessons Learned
> opencode server plugins: export default only. No named exports.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/akasai/omo-olympus/compare/v0.2.1...v0.2.8

## What's New
### Agent Detection
- **Concurrent tracking** — multiple instances of the same agent tracked; sleeps only when all finish
- **Error detection** — agents show error dialogue on `session.error` events (5-second display)
- **Main session mode switching** — Prometheus (plan mode) vs Sisyphus (build mode) via system prompt analysis
- **Session cleanup** — `session.deleted` handler prevents memory leaks
### Server Hooks
- `tool.execute.after` — task completion signals
- `command.execute.before` — mode-switching command detection (`/start-work`, `/omc-plan`)
- `experimental.chat.system.transform` — main session mode detection (writes only on mode change)
### Fixes
- `inferAgent` misclassification — removed description-based fallback
- `popPending` — skips `__done__` entries interleaved in the pending queue
- Stale `setTimeout` protection — sleep timers tracked and cleared on reactivation
### Tests
- 25 tests passing (vitest)
- Restored `personas.ts` as shared module
- Added hook coverage
### Docs
- README (EN/KO) updated with new features, known quirks, and dev symlink tip

## What's Changed
* feat: enhance agent detection with error states, concurrent tracking, and mode switching by @akasai in https://github.com/akasai/omo-olympus/pull/1
* docs: update README with new features, known quirks, and dev symlink tip by @akasai in https://github.com/akasai/omo-olympus/pull/2

## New Contributors
* @akasai made their first contribution in https://github.com/akasai/omo-olympus/pull/1

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/akasai/omo-olympus/compare/v0.1.0...v0.2.0
